rows.Location: Lahore. The survey places the saint's mosque and seminary near Mochi Darwaza and states the shrine was built at that seminary; it also notes Dyal Singh College is "right near his shrine." No province, district, address or coordinates given in the survey. Pin is Mochi Gate's own coordinate (an approximate landmark, not the shrine's exact position) — ask Saifullah for a precise pin when possible.

rows.Name: Darbar Ghazi Ilm Din Shaheed
rows.Location: Miani Sahib Graveyard, Lahore. The field survey itself locates the shrine only as “Lahore” (its one detail, ‘Railway Auqaf land,’ refers to the funeral prayer, not necessarily the burial site); the placement at Miani Sahib comes from published press accounts — see Bibliography. The pin is the graveyard landmark, shared with the other Miani Sahib entries, not the grave's exact position.

rows.Name: Darbar Hazrat Tahir Bandagi Qadri
rows.Location: Miani Sahib Graveyard, Lahore. Per the field survey, this shrine is the oldest seat within Miani Sahib Graveyard — the graveyard grew up around it over the centuries, not the reverse. The survey gives no street address, no coordinates, and no position within the graveyard's roughly 475 kanals beyond "alongside the mosque" that Hazrat Tahir Bandagi built.

rows.Name: Darbar Malik Ahmad Ayaz
rows.Location: Shah Alam Market; the survey places the mazar near Darbar Ali Hajveri Ganj Bakhsh (Data Darbar). No city, district, tehsil or province is stated anywhere in the survey for the shrine itself. Pin reuses Data Darbar's own coordinate, since the survey ties this shrine's location directly to it — an approximate landmark, not the shrine's exact position. Ask Saifullah for a precise pin when possible.
